title: THE HAND'S METRO // CHATAYA'S EXPRESS LINE
narrative: Tyrion crawls through the fireplace in the Tower of the Hand expecting a narrow dirty shaft. Instead, he steps onto a marble subterranean platform illuminated by brass lanterns. A six-car pneumatic subway train with lion hood ornaments sits idling on iron tracks. A plaque reads: 'LINE 1: TOWER OF THE HAND DIRECT TO CHATAYA'S VIP SUITE — BUILT BY TYWIN LANNISTER, 282 AC.' Tyrion drops his crossbow. 'Father didn't just visit whores... he built modern mass transit for them.'
resolvesPlotHole: Tywin Lannister's Secret Subterranean Transit Network
introducesPlotHole: The Lannister High-Speed Pneumatic Brothel Metro

options.text: Board the subway back up to Cersei's standoff in the solar.
Take the express branch line into the Merling Kingdom under the bay.
Accidentally detonate the unexploded wildfire cache under the tracks.
